text:
alex.m: quick async standup — keyflow smoke rotation status. what I did: kicked off KMS rotation dry-run against staging, reviewed last night's vuln scan results, and opened the compliance checklist draft. blockers: need infra approval for the IAM role change (PR open), and one of the staging nodes is failing health checks.

marie.s: what I did: validated rotation script (no plaintext leaks in logs), ran prefix-scan for cached keys, and triaged two medium findings from the scan. blocker: waiting on ryan to approve the role policy so the rotation can write new key metadata. next: will run a scoped rolling rotation on a single service and monitor. :eyes:

ryan.k: what I did: narrowed down the IAM policy diff — looks like the extra sts:AssumeRole statement was the culprit. I pushed a patch to the PR (link: https://rwd.example/pr/2341). quick command I used to repro locally:```
aws iam simulate-principal-policy --policy-source-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/rotation-runner --action-names kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
```
No blockers from my side besides someone to merge (ops gates). Happy to do the merge if alex signs off.

engsec-bot: nightly-vuln-scan completed: 2 medium, 7 low. Report URL: https://reports.internal/vuln/1717654321 (auto) :robot_face:

alex.m: thanks — @ryan.k if you can merge after a quick sanity check, we should be able to run the single-service rotation at 10:30am PT. @dina_p can you validate the service config has the new role ARN before we run?

dina_p: will do. I spotted a minor config mismatch in prod-like staging (env var KEYSTORE_ROLE still pointed to old role). I'll patch and run a smoke deploy, then post results. ETA 25m.

marie.s: ping @ryan.k for review on the policy doc in the PR, left inline comment about the deny-overrides ordering. also dropping a short checklist here for the run: 
- patch staging service env var (dina)
- merge role policy (ryan)
- run single-service rotation (marie)
- monitor logs + metrics for 15m (alex)
- rollback plan ready (dina)

ryan.k: acked, I'll take the merge now and add a quick test harness. :thumbsup:

alex.m: if the smoke rotation is clean, we'll schedule full rotation tomorrow during the low-traffic window. small note to everyone: capture at least one log snippet showing new key ARN in use and save to the rotation run ticket.

dina_p: smoke deploy complete — health checks passing, new role ARN patched. logs look good, no auth errors. posting snippet now:```
[2026-03-17T17:45:12Z] keystore: using key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345
```

marie.s: ran rotation on service-a, observed no error and metrics stable. closing my triage items for this window.

alex.m: great work team. I'll create the roll plan for tomorrow and attach the vuln triage notes. if anyone hits anything weird after merge, drop it here or ping me directly. :rocket:
